sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 · GitHub
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Zero demonstrates capabilities such as self-verification, reflection, and generating long CoTs, marking a significant milestone for the research community. Notably, it is the first open research to validate that reasoning capabilities of LLMs can be incentivized purely through RL, without the need for SFT.

sources.title: DeepSeek R1 | Advanced Reasoning AI for Complex Problems
sources.snippet: The Model That Changed Everything. DeepSeek R1 - the open-source reasoning model that matched OpenAI o1, crushed NVIDIA's stock price, and proved that frontier-level chain-of-thought AI didn't require proprietary infrastructure. Free. MIT licensed. Available to run on your laptop.
